jurisdiction.name: Afghanistan
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Afghanistan has published no national AI law, strategy, guidance or regulator AI document on its official websites. The communications ministry's pre-2021 ICT policy drafts do not mention AI, the current de facto authorities have published only procurement notices for AI training rather than governance documents, and there is no national data protection law or authority.
lead_institutions: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology
narrative.review_notes: This review was completed on 12 October 2026 and covers national law, government, ministries and regulators. The official websites were searched and no national AI governance documents were found.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: National-level official sources were searched, including the Ministry of Justice's Official Gazette (in Dari, Pashto and English), the telecommunications ministry's policies, the education ministries, the central bank and the telecom regulator. No qualifying AI-governance document was found in any category. Not yet verified from the official text: AI material of the Ministry of Higher Education and the telecom regulator.
coverage_audit.technical_note:
Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. moj.gov.af (Official Gazette) searched in Dari, Pashto and English: no AI results; MCIT policy drafts (ICT Policy 2015-2024 and 2018-2022, IT Industry Development Policy 2015-2020, 2015 Draft Cyber Security Plan) full-text searched: no AI terms; MCIT AI training procurement notices not recorded. Ministry of Higher Education site search 404; ATRA search returned no list (web search only). Not a party to Convention 108. Units covered: Law: Searched, nothing found. Ministry of Justice site (moj.gov.af, Official Gazette publisher) searched in Dari, Pashto and English for AI terms: no results. MCIT 'Laws' page lists telecom, e-transactions, access-to-information and procurement laws; none is AI-specific. No enacted national personal data protection law located on official sites. The 2017 Penal Code cybercrime chapter has no AI provisions (out of scope).; Government: Searched, nothing found. MCIT (mcit.gov.af) policies page read: ICT Policy 2015-2024 (draft), ICT Policy 2018-2022 (draft), IT Industry Development Policy 2015-2020 (draft), Open Access Policy, geospatial data policies; full-text check of the ICT/IT policies and the 2015 Draft Cyber Security Plan found no mention of AI. MCIT site search found only AI training/tool procurement notices for its IT innovation centre (not governance documents). No national AI strategy, framework, ethics or public-sector AI guidance found from either the former Republic government or the current de facto authorities.; Ministries: Searched, nothing found. Ministry of Education (moe.gov.af) site search returned only a news item on an education-technology innovation campaign; Ministry of Higher Education site search not available (404). No ministry-level AI policy or guidance located.; Regulators: Searched, nothing found. Da Afghanistan Bank (dab.gov.af) site search: no AI results. ATRA (atra.gov.af) reachable but site search returned no usable results; no AI documents in its listings. No data protection authority exists; no AI-specific cybersecurity, standards, procurement or competition documents found.. Not reached: Ministry of Higher Education site search (mohe.gov.af search path returned 404); ATRA site search non-functional (no result list returned). Could not verify: Ministry of Higher Education and ATRA site searches did not function; checked via web search only. binding-law, strategy, government-governance, ethics, risk-assurance, public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, data-privacy, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international, historical: no material found.
Wording note 2026-10-19 (coverage_audit.no_material_found_note): The Ministry of Higher Education and telecom regulator site searches were unavailable and were checked only through web search, so they remain to be checked.
